interest: Shows US-Colombian monitoring of Japanese interest near the Panama Canal, Buenaventura, and Colombian rivers, including oil concessions and aviation ties.
overview: Docket (Form DS-46, 1945) for 894.20221, 1932-39: twelve entries on Japanese activity in Colombia, including espionage rumors during the 1932 USS Gannet and Teal visit to Buenaventura, photographic reconnaissance in Cali, Atrato River settlements, and attempts to buy the Miller oil tract; most post-1937 records cross-referenced to the 821 series.

subfiles.about: A two-page Department of State List of Papers indexing twelve communications and cross-references from 1932 to 1939 regarding Japanese military, espionage, and economic activities in Colombia.
subfiles.summary: Twelve entries (1932-39) on suspected Japanese military and espionage activity in Colombia: the 1932 USS Gannet/Teal visit to Buenaventura, photographic reconnaissance in Cali, Atrato and Nariño settlements, and bids for Colombian oil concessions including the Miller tract; most post-1937 items cross-referenced to the 821 series.
subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers: Japanese Military Activities in Colombia
